units.source_text: 多年以来，夕雾对紫夫人并无何等野心，

en.t: For many years, Yugiri had held no particular designs on Lady Murasaki,

units.source_text: 他只希望找个机会，像昔年朔风那天似的再见一面，

en.t: he only hoped to find a chance to see her once more, as he had on that day of the north wind long ago,

units.source_text: 并且约略听听她的声音。

en.t: and to hear her voice, if only faintly.

units.source_text: 这愿望始终不离他的心头，

en.t: This wish never left his heart,

units.source_text: 但声音终于听不到了。

en.t: but in the end he never heard her voice.

units.source_text: 他想：“现在紫夫人虽已变成空空的遗骸，

en.t: He thought, "Though Lady Murasaki has now become only an empty remains,

units.source_text: 能见一面也好。

en.t: it would still be enough just to see her once.

units.source_text: 欲遂此愿，除了现在而外哪能再有机会呢？”

en.t: If I am to fulfill this wish, when could there be another chance besides now?"

units.source_text: 于是就不顾一切，流着眼泪，

en.t: So he threw caution aside and, with tears flowing,

units.source_text: 装作制止侍女们号哭的样子，叫道：“大家不要哭！

en.t: pretended to be stopping the waiting women from wailing and called out, "Everyone, do not cry!

units.source_text: 暂且肃静！”

en.t: Be quiet for a while!"

units.source_text: 乘着和父亲说话的机会，把帷屏的垂布撩开。

en.t: Taking the chance as he spoke with his father, he lifted the hanging cloth of the screen.

units.source_text: 此时将近黎明，室内光线阴暗，

en.t: It was nearly dawn then, and the room was dim,

units.source_text: 源氏正移近灯火，守候遗体。

en.t: while Genji had drawn the lamp closer and was keeping watch beside the body.

units.source_text: 夕雾但见紫夫人的相貌十全十美，

en.t: Yugiri saw only that Lady Murasaki's face was utterly perfect,

units.source_text: 真乃冰清玉洁，死去何等可惜！

en.t: so pure and stainless that her death seemed unbearably tragic.

units.source_text: 源氏看见夕雾窥视并不强要遮蔽。

en.t: Genji saw Yugiri looking in, but did not insist on hiding her from view.

units.source_text: 他说：“你看这样子！

en.t: He said, "Look at her like this!

units.source_text: 和生前毫无变异，然而分明已经无望了！”

en.t: She is no different from when she was alive, and yet clearly there is no hope left!"

units.source_text: 便举袖掩面而泣。

en.t: Then he raised his sleeve to cover his face and wept.

units.source_text: 夕雾也泪盈于睫，不能见物。

en.t: Yugiri too had tears brimming on his lashes and could not see.

units.source_text: 勉强睁开泪眼，拜观遗体，

en.t: He forced open his tearful eyes and reverently looked upon the body,

units.source_text: 一看之后，反觉无限悲伤，

en.t: but after one look, he felt an even more boundless sorrow,

units.source_text: 真个心神惑乱了。

en.t: and his mind and spirit were truly thrown into confusion.

units.source_text: 紫夫人的头发随随便便地披散着，

en.t: Lady Murasaki's hair lay loosely spread about,

units.source_text: 然而密密丛丛，全无半点纷乱，

en.t: yet it was thick and abundant, without the slightest disorder,

units.source_text: 光彩艳艳，美不可言。

en.t: glossy and radiant, beautiful beyond words.

units.source_text: 灯光非常明亮，把紫夫人的颜面照得雪白。

en.t: The lamplight was very bright, shining on Lady Murasaki's face until it looked snow white.

units.source_text: 比较起生前涂朱抹粉的相貌来，

en.t: Compared with the face she had shown in life, adorned with rouge and powder,

units.source_text: 这死后无知无觉地躺着时的容颜更见美丽。

en.t: her face as she lay there after death, unaware and unfeeling, seemed even more beautiful.

units.source_text: “十全无缺”一类的话，已经不够形容了。

en.t: Words like "flawless" were no longer enough to describe her.

units.source_text: 夕雾看见这相貌优美无比，

en.t: Seeing that face of incomparable beauty,

units.source_text: 连一点寻常之相也没有，

en.t: without even the slightest trace of anything ordinary,

units.source_text: 竟希望自己立刻死去，把灵魂附在紫夫人的遗体上。

en.t: Yugiri even wished that he might die at once and attach his soul to Lady Murasaki's body.

units.source_text: 这真是无理的愿望啊！

en.t: It was truly an unreasonable wish.
